coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Airbnb

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Workplace Operations teams each run their own processes, tools and vendors, and you need someone who can see across all of it and show where manual effort is piling up. I've spent five years in budgeting, forecasting and month-end reporting, and one problem there looked much like yours: a close process that took 9 working days because the checks were done by hand.

I automated the journal checks in Excel VBA and brought month-end close reporting down to 6 working days. As a Financial Analyst at Calder Industrial Components, I also rebuilt the forecast model for our larger business unit around order backlog, lifting accuracy from 88% to 96%, and I build Power BI dashboards on SAP data for plant managers. That is the habit your "measurement frameworks" and "data to drive decisions" call for: find where effort is wasted, fix it, and prove the result with numbers. I haven't run global programs or managed vendors, and I won't pretend otherwise. My background is in finance, and I'd bring analytical rigor, systems thinking in how I structure reporting, and a quick learning curve to the operational side of your roadmap.

I'd welcome a conversation about how that analytical approach could support your operational modernization work in San Francisco. I'm available to speak at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Tomas Brandt
